history.summary: 99yr leasehold 1,184sqft 4BR at The Esparis, D18 Pasir Ris, at $1.395M / $1,178 PSF — and crucially just 240m from the upcoming CR4 Pasir Ris East MRT (Cross Island Line). Affordable family 4BR with a concrete rail catalyst, though no URA data and a 99yr/2006 lease are the constraints.
history.rating_rationale: The standout fact is 240m to CR4 Pasir Ris East on the Cross Island Line (~2030) — within the 500m sweet spot that gets the strongest uplift, on a unit bought before the station opens. A 4BR at $1.395M / $1,178 PSF is a low-entry family unit with deep HDB-upgrader demand in Pasir Ris/Tampines. Drawbacks: no URA series to verify current value, 4BR is a narrower tenant segment, and 99yr LH from 2006. The forward CRL catalyst at a low price tips this to a Buy.
red_flags: No URA appreciation/txn/median data to verify current value
99yr leasehold from 2006 — lease decay over the hold
4BR is a family-only, narrower tenant pool
catalysts: 240m to upcoming CR4 Pasir Ris East MRT (Cross Island Line, ~2030) — within 500m uplift zone
Low $1.395M entry for a 4BR — strong HDB-upgrader demand in D18
Tampines Regional Centre / Pasir Ris precinct growth
